contract: Original float IntersectLine and do_anti_hairline compiled unchanged. Minimal fixed-point helpers and blitter adapters retain ordered per-pixel coverage and Direct/Pair routing; these vectors cover line construction and integer bitmap clipping, not native material blending, AA clip masks, path cap extension, curves or dashes.
eventEncoding: Gzip CSV; semicolon-separated events x:y:coverage:kind; kind 0=Direct, 1=Pair. Complete event order is preserved.
